result.summary: The page looks generally well-structured, but there is a misalignment in the 'Fastest near you' carousel: cards have inconsistent heights and vertical positions, causing text baselines to not align across the row.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the cards have inconsistent sizes and vertical alignment: 'Green Bowl Poké' card image is taller/starts higher than 'Smash Bros Burgers', whose image is vertically offset, making restaurant names and delivery fees sit at different heights across the row.
issues.suggestion: Use fixed-size card containers with consistent image heights so cards and their text align on the same baseline.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder text 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' appears low in contrast against the light gray input background.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast of the light gray placeholder text against the gray background to improve readability and accessibility.
